effects.audience: Rust library consumer / publication owner integrator
effects.platform: Public method compiled for Linux/macOS/Windows; selected GNU/Linux owner tests only, native macOS/Windows identity behavior unrun.
effects.before: A caller holding LifecycleLease had no public borrow of its pinned Project for a distinct publication owner journal.
effects.after: LifecycleLease::publication_journal_project publicly borrows the held Project so an external publication crate can store/read its own local journal under the same root; the borrow is not remote publication authority or a protected effect grant.

effects.platform: In-process fake remote only; no native remote adapter or macOS/Windows execution proof.
effects.before: No internal first-tag fake owner journal bound to C1 request, plan and remote generation.
effects.after: A crate-private fake port records Ready and per-tag Pending/Landed/result identity, treats lost replies as uncertain, and refuses malformed retained records without replay; it is not a shipped publication route.

effects.platform: In-process fake remote only; no native GitHub write or cross-platform remote proof.
effects.before: No internal full-plan fake owner retained each partition boundary and independently compared post-observed object transitions.
effects.after: A crate-private fake port records per-partition Pending/Landed and terminal result, checks remote generation and typed tag/release/asset/visibility changes, and leaves uncertain partitions unrerun. This endpoint has no cold-by-key capsule or live adapter.

user_impact.reason: An additive public LifecycleLease::publication_journal_project Rust API exposes the held local journal root to library consumers; the fake publication owners remain private, no live CLI/MCP/GitHub route is enabled, and 1.0.x user-owned state needs no conversion.

documentation_impact.reason: Developer API guidance should explain the public lease-root borrow and its limited local-journal purpose, while publication guidance keeps the fake owner and live-unavailable boundary explicit; final topic/editorial proof remains pending.
